content_record.editorial_body: Some products marketed as dietary supplements or foods contain undeclared drugs. The FDA's searchable list can help you check. Three things to remember - Hidden drug ingredients can appear in 'all natural' products. - The FDA maintains a searchable notification list online. - Check specific products before you buy or use them. Source This signal is based on Sleep, Skin, Bodybuilding and Other Product Notifications from FDA Tainted Supplements. Read the original report for full context. Health note: The FDA list does not specify which products are affected or how often it is updated. This does not mean all supplements are unsafe.
